b: That afternoon we set off for another place called Hoi An.. It's not far.. We went by car.. We got there and went to the rooms by the evening..

A nice place.. It felt a bit like the countryside.. The place we stayed was lovely too…One room on the ground floor.. one room up on the fourth floor.. As soon as we arrived we put the bags down in the ground-floor room and sat.. Thushara and the two boys went up to see what the upstairs room was like.. When they came back, Sing Keeth said just to stir things that the upstairs room wasn't nice, and Thushara gave it away by saying the room was lovely..

Our Kovai Sarala has a bit of a problem with upstairs.. So do we all.. but less than her.. When she insisted that she wanted the nice room, would these boys let it go .. They're the ones who'd beat her.. They dug their heels in, we won't give it.. After a silly fight it was finally decided: boys upstairs today, girls upstairs tomorrow..
When all that was done we set off to see a place called the Old Town.. An old place .. single-storey buildings .. narrow lanes .. but terribly clean.. No cars go in there… so you have to walk in..

Inside, she took us to a food place called "Com Linh", saying we absolutely had to go.. There too, all I could have was a coffee.. As usual they tucked in properly .. I gawked as much as I could.. After talking there till our mouths ached, we left and wandered around the town

For the first time since we came, we saw a police station.. In a tiny place like a six-by-six kiosk, a table and a chair.. In it sat a man in a green uniform like a security guard.. He must have been the policeman… Compared with the army people we saw in Vietnam, there are fewer of these.. Since the army does all the work, it seems these ones don't have much to do

Walking on, there were lots of shops, like Pettah.. In all of them there were all kinds of things, beautiful handicrafts, clothes, hats, jewellery.. Whatever you asked about, they'd quote a price that's much too high..If we frowned they'd say tell us your price, and even if we said half, they'd nod yes at once..Not knowing this trick, we bought a few things at the price they said.. Otherwise we'd have asked for another one free..

We're buying lots of things in one place.. we can buy elsewhere too, we thought, so we stopped buying and looked around.. Mithra didn't tell us that we wouldn't be able to buy things this cheap anywhere else.. She alone quietly bought everything.. If we'd known, we'd have bought loads too
After that we set off to catch some lanterns
note: Kovai Sarala is the comic actress the author jokingly compares Mithra to. Pettah is Colombo's crowded bazaar.
